1.translation: By those who pull out [evil souls][1] harshly,

2.translation: and by those who draw out [good souls][2] gently,

3.translation: and by those who glide swiftly[3],
3.footnotes: [3] i.e., angels glide swiftly through the heavens and earth with Allah’s command.

4.translation: and those who overtake one another as in a race[4],

5.translation: and those who carry out the command [of Allah],

6.translation: on the Day when the earth convulses [by the first Blast],

8.translation: hearts[5] will be pounding on that Day,
8.footnotes: [5] Of those who denied the Resurrection.

9.translation: and their eyes[6] will be downcast.

10.translation: They say, “Will we be brought back to life,

11.translation: after we have turned into decayed bones[7]?”
11.footnotes: [7] They would say this in ridicule of the warning.

12.translation: They say, “Then that would surely be a losing return[8]!”

13.translation: It will only be a single Blast,

14.translation: then they will immediately be above the ground.

15.translation: Has there come to you the story of Moses,

16.translation: when his Lord called out to him at the sacred valley of Tuwa?

17.translation: [Saying,] “Go to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed all bounds”.

18.translation: And say: ‘Are you willing to be purified,

19.translation: and I will guide you to your Lord so that you may fear Him?’”

20.translation: Then Moses showed him the greatest sign[9].
20.footnotes: [9] i.e., the miracle of the staff turning into a snake. See 20:17-23.

21.translation: But Pharaoh denied it and disobeyed.

22.translation: Then he turned back striving to plot.

24.translation: saying, “I am your lord, the most high.”

25.translation: So Allah seized him for an exemplary punishment in this life and in the Hereafter[10].
25.footnotes: [10] Or for his claim of being the greatest god and for his previous oppression of the Children of Israel.

26.translation: Indeed, there is a lesson in this for those who fear Allah.

27.translation: Are you more difficult to create or the heaven that He built?

28.translation: He raised its vault high and proportioned it,

29.translation: and darkened its night and brought forth its daylight.

30.translation: And thereafter He spread out the earth,

31.translation: brought forth from it its water and its pasture,

33.translation: as a provision for you and your grazing livestock.

34.translation: But when the Supreme Calamity comes[11],
34.footnotes: [11] i.e., the second Blast which marks the Day of judgment.

35.translation: on that Day man will remember all what he did,

36.translation: and the Blazing Fire will be exposed for all to see.

38.translation: and preferred the life of this world,

39.translation: the Blazing Fire will be their abode.

40.translation: But those who feared standing before their Lord and restrained themselves from evil desires,

41.translation: Paradise will surely be their abode.

42.translation: They ask you concerning the Hour, “When will it be[12]?”

43.translation: How could you possibly mention that?

44.translation: Its knowledge rests only with your Lord[13].
44.footnotes: [13] i.e., its end and termination. Its ultimate knowledge belongs to Allah alone.

45.translation: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

46.translation: On the Day when they see it[14], it will be as if they had remained [in this world] no more than an evening or a morning.
